label: gdn2_speedrun_rescored
recipe_note: the banked best row's own recipe: RMS-matched Muon at the SPEEDRUN LR point -- 5x GDN2's own banked AdamW LR -- the config the constant-LR velocity probe selected
conventions_note: DELIVERABLE 1, GDN2's side: the 1.3951 row's own config (option B, 5x, seed 3401) re-scored under the corrected instrument

no_prediction.rule: NO DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION is pre-stated for any arm: the literature does not say which machine benefits more from the corrected instrument or from the Moonlight LR point -- the gate-surface difference (our 27.7K learned gate params vs GDN2's 27.4M) makes both directions live; this lane measures, and any reversal is reported as plainly as any confirmation

corrected_scoring.primary: post-cooldown eval: a linear cooldown of 24 steps (13.3% of the 180-step constant-LR budget) appended after the banked matched-exposure landing, same stream/data order, LR factor (25 - k)/24 for cooldown step k (1.0 -> 1/24, never zero), both hybrid groups scaling equally; the corrected score is the post-cooldown calibration eval
corrected_scoring.secondary: EMA iterate at step 180 (no extra data): decay 0.99, initialized at the init weights, updated after every constant-phase optimizer step, NOT updated during the cooldown; RANKING-ONLY -- its absolute number is biased toward mid-run weights (stated, not smoothed)
corrected_scoring.exposure_note: the cooldown steps see ~2.7M more targets (~13%), identical across arms -- a stated protocol EXTENSION; the step-180 constant-LR eval is retained so every banked row stays comparable

citations.river_valley: Wen et al., ICLR 2025, arXiv:2410.05192 -- constant-LR loss carries an LR-dependent oscillation penalty that decay/averaging removes
citations.cooldown: Haegele et al., NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2405.18392 -- constant-LR + short cooldown matches cosine at full scale
citations.averaging: Defazio et al., arXiv:2405.15682 -- iterate averaging as the schedule-free fix for the same penalty
citations.moonlight: Liu et al. (Moonshot AI), arXiv:2502.16982 -- with the update RMS matched to AdamW's (~0.2; AdamW typical 0.2-0.4), Muon directly reuses the LR and weight decay tuned for AdamW, i.e. ~1x the AdamW-tuned LR, WITH weight decay
citations.horizon: Bjorck et al., ICLR 2025 -- the optimal LR shrinks with token horizon; probe-tuned LRs transfer only downscaled

optimizer_step_seconds.note: steps 10+; the honest clock's own measure, per step

banked.note: the banked same-seed row's constant-LR final; the re-run's step-180 score is receipted against it (GPU nondeterminism may move later steps; step 1 is asserted bit-identical)

cooldown_note: the smoke shakedown runs 3 cooldown steps; every real arm runs the approved 24 (13.3% of 180)

scores.note: ranking-only: biased toward mid-run weights (stated, not smoothed)

diagnostics.note: gdn2's own gate telemetry per layer, averaged over the calibration probe windows: the channel-wise log-decay's retention exp(g) (the state's per-token survival factor; its reciprocal-of-complement is the implied memory horizon), the erase gate b and the write gate w -- the state's own write/forget coefficients, recomputed from the module's own projections in a non-invasive forward hook

rms_matching_note: measured on THIS arm: the Muon group's update RMS (the hybrid's own metric) vs the aux AdamW group's update RMS (the metrics-only subclass) -- the Moonlight receipt on our machines

config.model_build: matched_arms.build_gdn2 verbatim (the registered lattice_gdn2 arm, its searched nomination's knobs)

optimizer.optimizer: bakeoff_optimizers.HybridMuonX45 (imported verbatim through a metrics-only subclass that records the aux AdamW group's update RMS; no update path touched)
optimizer.lr_convention: 5x the machine's own tuned AdamW LR -- the speedrun point the constant-LR probe selected
optimizer.weight_decay_note: decoupled, at the machine's own tuned value (already in the hybrid; Moonlight requires weight decay)
optimizer.warmup_note: both hybrid groups scale equally (the prior line's convention, every banked hybrid arm's own)
optimizer.rms_matching: the pinned Moonshot 0.2*sqrt(max(shape)) scaling (hybrid_muon.scaled_update) matches the orthogonalized update's RMS to AdamW's ~0.2 class BY CONSTRUCTION; measured on every arm here (muon_update_rms vs adamw_update_rms)

config.routing: option B (gates-on-AdamW, the control's own arm)

horizon_transfer_rule.rule: board runs transfer probe-optimal LRs DOWNSCALED: eta_board = eta_probe_opt * (D_probe / D_board)^alpha, with alpha FIT at our scale from a two-budget bracket (re-run the top config at 2x probe budget and take the local optimum shift) -- Bjorck et al.'s power-law FORM, never their imported exponent (fitted at far larger scale); PLUS the hard gate: top-k configs must hold rank stability at 2x probe budget under the corrected scoring before any board transfer
horizon_transfer_rule.board_targets_estimate: ~91.7M (2700 s at gdn2's banked 33,958 bytes/s), ~4.6x the probe exposure
horizon_transfer_rule.alpha_provenance: DEFERRED to the board-prep stage: the two-budget bracket that fits alpha is a multi-arm search outside this lane's budget; the rule is pre-stated now and the fit is labelled as not-yet-run
horizon_transfer_rule.hard_gate: rank stability at 2x probe budget under the corrected scoring is a HARD gate for any board transfer

config.checkpoint_note: state snapshots taken inside the training loop at each constant-phase checkpoint step, at the post-cooldown final step, plus the EMA iterate at step 180 (constant-phase only); every eval runs on restored snapshots after training, so the training path is unperturbed by construction
config.stopping_rule: matched-EXPOSURE: train until 20000000 targets seen (the banked probe exposure, constant LR), THEN the 24-step linear cooldown (the corrected-scoring extension, same stream); the honest elapsed wall is reported first-class, with the constant-phase wall reported separately
config.symmetry_rule: same stream, same data order, same matched-exposure stopping rule, same honest clock, same grad clip, same calibration eval as the banked rows; the ONLY differences are the LR point (speedrun vs Moonlight) and the scoring instrument (constant-LR step-180 eval vs post-cooldown vs EMA), receipted per arm
